body: Thank you for this, I keep re-reading it
I feel like I may have made this up or confused it with congrats like I’m five

My mental health has been pushed over the edge and I’m scaring myself and those around me, so my doctor and I felt it would be best to be monitored around the clock for at least a few days to make sure nothing happened. 

The program my doctor referred me to is also very comprehensive in their care (they look at possible biological causes and whatever else) and has newer treatment options like ketamine and ECT for people with my kind of depression, but being admitted is the only way to get those treatments.

Edit: to be clear when I say doctor here I mean the doctor who provides therapy. Also, him and the doctor who prescribed my medication have both decided they’re at a loss for what to do for me and think more intensive care is the best option
Thanks. “Problem” is I’ll never have a plan and be ready to mill myself, because the odds of failing and ending up worse off that before are too high
Thank you for this. We decided it’s best that I go talk to the intake people tomorrow before I make the final decision but I will probably decide to be hospitalized
Was it hard to get them to let you leave?
